title: Random Biome Remover
description: Every 5 minutes removes a random biome from the world.
body:
Every 5 minutes a random biome gets removed from the entire world. Inspired by Sapnaps [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UqP1n2c_ucE). There are many commands for customization type /bd or /biomedeleter, or change the timer countdown.

THIS IS THE FIRST RELEASE EXPECT BUGS!!

**[disclaimer]**
If the biome deleted near you your game will be frozen from 2-10 seconds, and possibly a crash.
